mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT LEVEL, C.* FROM ( SELECT ONETALK_NO, ONETALK_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(ONETALK_WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일" HH24"시" MI"분" SS"초"') AS ONETALK_WRITE_DATE, MEMBER_NO, WORKER_NICKNAME, BUSINESS_NAME, BUSINESS_NICKNAME, MEMBER_NAME, PARENT_ONETALK_NO, ONETALK_DEL_FL FROM "ONETALK" LEFT JOIN "MEMBER" USING(MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "WORKER" USING(MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "EMPLOYER" USING(MEMBER_NO)) C WHERE (ONETALK_DEL_FL = 'N' OR 0 != (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ONETALK" SUB WHERE SUB.PARENT_ONETALK_NO = C.ONETALK_NO AND ONETALK_DEL_FL = 'N')) AND (BUSINESS_NICKNAME = '본점' OR BUSINESS_NICKNAME IS NULL) START WITH PARENT_ONETALK_NO IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR ONETALK_NO = PARENT_ONETALK_NO ORDER SIBLINGS BY ONETALK_NO
